_note: Code-first changes to the prototype on top of data/screens.json (the pure Figma export), applied by tools/build_prototype.py load_screens(). Each one is pending a Figma sync (status.json > prototype.pending_figma_sync); after the sync and a re-export its nodes are gone from the export and the change reports 'synced'.

changes.description: Remove the Discover What's New section (Dark 27:1708, Light 31:859); the frame gets 236 shorter (1725 -> 1489) so the Mini Player and Bottom Navigation stay at the bottom.

Repeat the Just You section (Section Header + 3 Media Cards, same content) under Melancholic Egyptian Pop (Dark 27:1626 after 27:1667, Light 31:845 after 31:852); the frame gets 264 taller so the Mini Player and Bottom Navigation stay at the bottom.
Share Button (Icon Button, Dark 27:866, Light 31:747) opens the Share Sheet as an overlay.
The Lyrics Header's Share Icon Button (Dark 56:5361, Light 56:5423) opens the Share Sheet as an overlay (adapters.json: Lyrics Header click -> onShare).

Share flow (flow map: Now Playing / Lyrics -> Share -> Share Sheet -> Copy link -> Link Copied -> Now Playing; the other targets, Cancel and the scrim close the sheet). Share Sheet = bottom Sheet (Position=Bottom) over md/sys/color/scrim at 0.32, on surface_container_low, top corners extra_large, padding 16, gap 16: title 'Share' (M3/headline_small, on_surface); header Artwork 56 + Track Metadata (track title, artist), 24 above a row of 5 share targets (Icon Button Tonal + label M3/label_medium on_surface_variant, 8 apart): Copy link, Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram Stories, More; Divider; Button Text 'Cancel'. Copy link -> Link Copied (Now Playing with a Plain Tooltip 'Link copied' as the confirmation; the DS has no Snackbar). Target icons are stand-ins from the DS set until the icons exist in Figma: Copy link Icon/upload, Messages Icon/groups, WhatsApp Icon/share, Instagram Stories Icon/auto_awesome, More Icon/more_vert.
changes.figma_note: Share Sheet frames keep their code-first tree with the Figma ids (115:4806 / 115:4889): the screens export does not read Sheet slot content yet (2026-11-01).
